sentence: The engine was so badly damaged that it was ______, so we had to replace it. (repair)
explanation: We need an adjective meaning 'cannot be fixed' after 'was'. The prefix un- reverses the meaning of 'repairable', and the suffix -able means 'able to be'. Turkish speakers may find this easy to map, because Turkish also builds negative ability adjectives with a suffix, but English splits the same idea across a prefix and a suffix.
